prior_verdict_semantics_records.name: claim-reason-requirements.yaml
prior_verdict_semantics_records.assessment: Bounded governed claim-shape rules, intersected with the episode path, distinguish placement, routing and closure relevance, token dependencies, robustness and scoped currency exemption. The table makes no universal governance-calculus claim. Strict soundness additionally requires claim-wise factive truth linkage.

prior_verdict_semantics_records.name: verdict-registry.yaml
prior_verdict_semantics_records.assessment: Four status values, 14 semantic verdict IDs, 11 result-free core path IDs. Only truth linkage entails result correctness claim-wise; reliability, ex-ante justification and robustness have explicit non-entailments. Display aliases and historical migration are not operative IDs.

prior_verdict_semantics_records.name: metaortheme.schema.json
prior_verdict_semantics_records.assessment: States are a declared set, selectors typed and uncertain/overlapping selection needs semantics. Description says exactly one policy or policy reference, while the actual anyOf permits both. Fresh schema control confirms that cardinality mismatch; no adoption/repair choice is made.

prior_verdict_semantics_records.name: metaorthemma.schema.json
prior_verdict_semantics_records.assessment: Case-bound token is single-typed with nonempty material binding, occurrence/analysis anchors, scoped dependent claims or an explicit external/no-claim reason, binder warrant and declared validity. Binder/executor role distinction does not force different actors. Plural MetaInst is explicitly not implemented.

prior_verdict_semantics_records.name: derive_reqpath.py
prior_verdict_semantics_records.assessment: Derives the episode path from governance rules and registry in conceptual order, with a per-core trace. Default fixture mode checks rule coverage; --shape returns before this sanity check. Shape truthiness assumes a correctly typed declaration; it does not authenticate governance or infer the actual shape.

prior_verdict_semantics_records.name: validate_claim_reasoning_paths.py
prior_verdict_semantics_records.assessment: Recomputes episode and claim paths independently of the recorded claim projection for its eight declared fixture families. Adequate reasoning is non-factive; strict soundness uses token truth linkage. Tests route/closure independence, mixed claims, luck, rare miss, unresolved status and projection omission. This fixture checker is not called by collect_issues for arbitrary bundles.

prior_verdict_semantics_records.name: validate_cross_record_semantics.py
prior_verdict_semantics_records.assessment: Full 843-line control-flow read. Checks local identity/version anchors, inheritance, scope, cycles, timestamps, dispositions and supplied-path aggregation. It checks token/route requirements but does not fully rederive episode ReqPath; claim derivation then intersects with that supplied path, leaving an upstream omission gap. Rule-load exception is swallowed and skips the claim-derivation equality check. Bundle-local consistency only; external facts and global store invariants are not established.
prior_verdict_semantics_records.execution_scope: Four controlled counterbundles via exact collect_issues, plus import-time missing-rule fault injection

prior_verdict_semantics_records.name: validate_negative_fixtures.py
prior_verdict_semantics_records.assessment: Loads every schema, checks negative fixtures at their declared layer, and uses any semantic issue as the rejection criterion. Its own generator implements only three top-level operators. Correct shape-layer rejection does not prove the named semantic reason is uniquely responsible; recursive and Task14 dispatchers are separate unexecuted mechanisms.

prior_verdict_semantics_records.name: validate_schemas.py
prior_verdict_semantics_records.assessment: Full 133 lines read. Registry enum/core membership, NA reasons, factivity and aggregation are checked on examples. No comparison to the governance-derived episode path is made. current-state derived.schemas is used only for inventory equality; nine bundle filenames and schema compilation are custody/shape assurance, not semantic proof.
prior_verdict_semantics_records.execution_scope: Exact CLI on one synthetic counterbundle and explicit synthetic ten-schema inventory; all record checks pass, exit 1 only for expected nine-bundle denominator
